addendum_v2.basis: v1: ours 32.1% -> 26.1% topple on 37 forks; engine filter 36.4% because 'no split' accepts actions whose futures all topple (10/37). Futures that agree are not necessarily safe; and a pure least-change rule would favour missed grasps

rule_v2.ours: among candidates the monitor does not flag, pick the one whose predicted hold-30 futures (mean of the 64) are closest to the centroid of the MAJORITY group of the intended action's own predicted futures (split-test groups at offset 0; if the intended action is not flagged it is executed as before); ties by smaller offset; abstain if all flagged
rule_v2.engine: same structure with the truth_B futures: among candidates whose truth_B topple count is 0-1 or 63-64 (no split), keep those whose majority outcome (topple / stay) equals the intended action's truth_B majority; pick the smallest offset

addendum_v2.task_deviation: truth rollouts re-run with the same draws recording the target block's end position; deviation of a candidate = median over the 64 paired futures of the distance between its target end position and the intended action's (offset 0)
addendum_v2.metrics: as v1 plus median task deviation (mm) for the executed candidates, per policy; v1 policies re-reported beside
